title: Week 20 Check-In · The Whipping Boy
description: This week the prince gave away Jemmy’s hiding place, Jemmy ran for the forest, the boys met Betsy, and Jemmy went back for the prince. You practiced prepositions, the root spect (look), long words, and soft c and g. Show what you know!

questions.text: Which word in this sentence is a preposition? “Jemmy hid under the straw.”
questions.status: fixed (option “barn” removed; there is no barn in the book)

questions.text: Fill in the prepositions and write the whole sentence: “Jemmy crept ___ the dark forest and hid ___ a hollow tree.” (Use: through, inside)
Write a sentence that tells where a character is hiding. Use at least one preposition.
The root spect means “look.” Break apart the word inspect. What does it mean?

questions.text: What did the prince do that gave Jemmy away? Use a detail from the passage.
Jemmy asked the prince to tell Cutwater he slipped out the door. Why is the prince’s answer such a surprise to Jemmy?

questions.text: Do you think the prince knew how wrong his choice was? Use what you know about his character to explain.

Model sentence: “Under the moldy straw, Jemmy held very still and waited for his chance to run.” Notice how the prepositional phrase at the start puts you right into the scene. Write your own sentence that begins with a prepositional phrase.
In Chapter 15, Jemmy has the coach stop for the prince. Write 1–2 sentences: why do you think Jemmy went back for him?

passage.title: Reading passage (summary of Ch. 12–13)
passage.text: Jemmy burrowed under the moldy straw in the outlaws’ hut, waiting for his chance to slip away. He asked the prince to tell Cutwater that he had slipped out the door. But when Cutwater asked where the prince was, Prince Brat answered right away: “Him? Over there. Under the straw.” Jemmy burst out of the straw and ran for his life, with Cutwater close behind. But this, he had not expected: when he finally stopped running, the prince had followed him.
